details.description:
Meet your new go-to refreshment — Tetley Kombucha Zero Sugar. Crafted with Tetley’s signature tea expertise, this is where timeless brewing meets a new-age lifestyle.
Delicious, crisp, and effortlessly refreshing, it’s designed for those who want more from what they sip. With zero sugar, every bottle delivers a balanced taste that feels as good as it tastes no heaviness, no compromise.
Whether you’re powering through your day, unwinding post-work, or just vibing with friends, this is refreshment that keeps up. Available in bold, feel-good flavours like Pineapple and Cranberry, each sip is bright, smooth, and made to match your mood.
Chill it, sip it, and keep it light because great taste doesn’t need the extra sugar.
details.ingredients: Kombucha Base (Water, Sugar^, Black Tea, Pink Salt, Kombucha Culture), Natural and Nature-Identical Flavouring Substance, Lemon Juice Concentrate, Live Culture (Bacillus subtilis) (0.04%), Non-Caloric Sweetener (INS 955), Carbon Dioxide^. During fermentation, microorganisms metabolize the sugar and convert it into lactic acid.
